search_text: published ZDI-17-834 ZDI-CAN-4808 Hewlett Packard Enterprise Intelligent Management Center mibFileServlet Directory Traversal Denial of Service Vulnerability 2017-10-03 CVE-2017-12559 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-12559 6.8 AV:N/AC:L/Au:S/C:N/I:N/A:C ['Hewlett Packard Enterprise'] ['Intelligent Management Center'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to delete arbitrary files on vulnerable installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Intelligent Management Center. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within mibFileServlet servlet, which listens on TCP ports 8080 and 8443 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to delete any files accessible to SYSTEM. Hewlett Packard Enterprise has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://h20564.www2.hpe.com/hpsc/doc/public/display?docId=emr_na-hpesbhf03777en_us ['2017-05-11 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2017-10-03 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Steven Seeley (mr_me) of Offensive Security https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-17-834/
